# TEST-0004 — Historical boundary retired without replacement

## Context

The old boundary was conditional and later ceased to apply.

## Alternatives

| Option | Benefit | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| A | Retain the boundary | Carries obsolete constraints |
| B | End the boundary | No replacement contract |

## Decision

We ended the old boundary without replacing it.

## Consequences

The historical expiry remains visible without implying a successor.

## Consultation

This was a solo decision.

## Reversal condition

Create a new decision if the boundary becomes relevant again.
